works_in: Any green deck, best with extra land drops
hook: Play an untapped land and you get two mana out of it. One of them is any color.
reasons: Every land that hits the battlefield makes an extra mana, tapped ones included.
Fetch lands set it off twice — once for the fetch, once for the land it grabs.
The mana is any color. Green ramp normally just hands you basics.
watch_out: It's a 2/1, so it dies to anything. And the mana empties at end of phase — play the land once you know what you're spending it on.
question: What's your go-to two-mana ramp in Commander?
